data.title: Timeline hides finished, unplanned work with no epic by default; --all shows it
data.why: On this repository's journal the no-epic group was 92 rows, 85 of them closed tasks that never had a plan; the plan the timeline is for sat under them. Owner chose to hide them on 2026-10-31. They are counted (hiddenFinished) and named with --all, so nothing disappears silently. Finished work under an epic stays: the epic is the plan it belongs to.
data.rejected: Keep every actual bar in the group (DEC-73 as first built): history buries the plan; Hide finished work everywhere, epics included: an epic's bar would lose the part already delivered
